  background: "#F1E8D5"

constraints:
  - Locked S83 narration and canonical word timing end at 56.432s; final CTA holds through 56.533333s/1696 frames to preserve the 56.523s voice receipt
  - Original Trust logo artwork only after its exact image source is recorded; rights and permission remain NOT ASSESSED
  - No BBC photos/screenshots or Heidi product screenshots; use only short exact source-text excerpts with publisher/date attribution

  - All meaningful on-screen text, quotes and source credits are at least 42 px; captions are at least 46 px

One continuous paper record carries the viewer from the measured task to the evidence boundary. Short exact Trust/BBC text excerpts sit on the paper with source and date labels. The single red pencil intervention belongs to the BBC correction. The source sheet turns over once; on its reverse, two evidence fields separate. All lettering remains above the caption band.
